blurb: Step aboard a classic de Havilland Otter floatplane and lift off from downtown Juneau’s historic seaplane base for a journey that captures the true spirit of Alaska. Every seat is a window seat, every flight a front-row view of five magnificent glaciers flowing from the Juneau Icefield - Norris, Taku, Hole-In-The-Wall, East Twin, and West Twin. This glacier flightseeing route is the heart of every Wings Airways
extraNote: YOU'RE ALL SET!
